jobs.description:
Job Description
  
  

Specialist Technical Project Management
  
The Opportunity
  
  

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130\-year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data\-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Join a team that is passionate about using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision\-making and create custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the worlds greatest health threats.


Our Technology Centres focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our companys IT operating model, Tech Centres are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in the growth, success, and well\-being of our people to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging, to managing critical emergencies. Together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centres.
  
  

Role Overview
  
We are seeking a Product Manager to own the strategic direction, reliability, and scalability of our end\-to\-end clinical platform ecosystem. This ecosystem — spanning data capture, trial data management and monitoring, analysis reporting, and regulatory submission systems — directly enables clinical pipeline operations and the delivery of therapies to patients.
  
You will serve as the point of accountability for ecosystem health, driving proactive reliability, cross\-platform risk management, and scalable sustainment capabilities. You will balance short\-term operational needs with long\-term platform evolution, ensuring the ecosystem is always ready to support regulatory milestones without disruption.
  
  

What will you do
  
Define and maintain a unified sustainment roadmap across all clinical platform components
  
* Evolve CPS from reactive incident response to predictive, data\-driven reliability management
* Provide stakeholder updates with consolidated views of ecosystem health, risks, and investment needs
* Work with the business to identify business value for our initiatives and determine the best way to measure that our solutions achieve the targeted business value


What should you have
  
  

**Education:**  

Bachelors degree in computer science, Information Systems, or a related experience
  
  

**Required Experience and Skills:**  

* Minimum 1\-4 years of experience as a ProductManager/Business Analyst or similar role
* Experience with working within a global team
* Ability to adapt to rapidly changing technology and apply it to business needs
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to manage competing priorities and coordinate across multiple stakeholders.
* Self\-driven and able to work independently.


Primary Skills
  
  

* Experience managing project budgets, performing cost estimations, analyzing financial data, ensuring compliance with financial regulations, and making informed decisions to optimize resource allocation and project investments
* Proven experience in leading complex technical projects in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong technical background with knowledge of software development, systems integration, or related areas
* Excellent organizational and decision\-making skills. Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities
* Proficiency in project management tools (JIRA, Confluence, Trello, MS Project)
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills to liaise with cross\-functional teams
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and adapt to changing priorities


**Who we are:**  

We are known as Merck Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been inventing for lives, bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the worlds most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.
  
  

**What we look for:**  

Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.
  
  

\#HYDIT2025
  
  

**Required Skills:**  

Business Analysis, Business Analysis, Business Case Development, Business Management, Business Process Design, Change Management, Computer Science, Customer Project Management, Data Capturing, Financial Risk Management (FRM), Incident Management, Information Systems, Information Systems Management, Investment Management, Investment Risk Management, IT Automation, IT Infrastructure Management, IT Solution Design, Network Infrastructure Management, Portfolio Risk Management, Project Deliverables, Risk Management, Technical Problem Resolution, Technology Adaptation, Training Content Development {\+ 2 more}
  
  

**Preferred Skills:**

* Degree (BS/BA) in in Information Systems or Management, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science or Engineering, or related field required.
* Ability to develop long\-term product strategies aligned with business goals.
* 5\+ years of Product Management experience
Experience with Medical/Clinical Research/Safety (Systems: * \- Argus, Aeris,etc.)
* Strong leadership skills to guide cross\-functional teams and influence stakeholders.
* Proficiency in analyzing market trends, customer needs, and competitive landscape.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills for clear and effective information sharing.
* Strong analytical skills to identify issues and develop innovative solutions.
* Solid understanding of the technical aspects of product development.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring timely delivery.
* Deep understanding of customer needs and the ability to translate them into product features.
* Proficiency in using data and metrics to drive product decisions.
* Ability to adapt to changing market conditions and pivot strategies as needed.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description:
**Our Company:**


At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.


**What you will do:**


In this role you will lead a critical and highly visible function within Teradata Vantage platform. You will be given the opportunity to autonomously deliver the technical direction of the service, and the feature roadmap. You will work with extraordinary talent and have the opportunity to shape the team to best execute on the product.


**Job Responsibilities:**


* Design, develop, and scale intelligent software systems that power autonomous AI agents capable of reasoning, planning, acting, and learning in real\-world environments.
* Lead the implementation of core Agentic AI components — including agent memory, context\-aware planning, multi\-step tool use, and self\-reflective behavior loops.
* Architect robust, cloud\-native backends that support high\-throughput agent pipelines across major Cloud Service Providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), ensuring best\-in\-class observability, fault tolerance, and scalability.
* Build seamless integrations with large language models (LLMs) such as GPT\-4, Claude, Gemini, or open\-source models — using advanced techniques like function calling, dynamic prompting, and multi\-agent orchestration.
* Design and implement standardized context management and sharing using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to enable consistent, interoperable agent and tool interactions.
* Develop scalable APIs and services to connect agents with internal tools, vector databases, RAG pipelines, and external APIs.
* Own technical delivery of major agent\-related features, leading design reviews, code quality standards, and engineering best practices.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with researchers, ML engineers, product managers, and UX teams to translate ideas into intelligent, performant, and production\-ready systems.
* Define and implement testing strategies to validate agentic behavior in both deterministic and probabilistic conditions.
* Guide junior engineers and peers by mentoring, unblocking challenges, and championing a culture of technical excellence.
* Continuously evaluate emerging frameworks, libraries, and research to drive innovation in our Agentic AI stack.

**What makes you a qualified candidate:**


* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in backend development, distributed systems, or AI infrastructure, with a proven track record of delivering in high\-scale environments.
* Expertise in building and deploying AI\-integrated software, particularly with LLMs and frameworks like LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or custom orchestrators.
* Strong development skills in Python (preferred), Go, Java, or similar languages used in intelligent system design.
* Practical knowledge of agentic AI principles — including task decomposition, autonomous decision\-making, memory/context management, and multi\-agent collaboration.
* Experience implementing or integrating the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to facilitate standardized agent context management and interoperability across tools.
* Extensive experience with Cloud Service Providers (AWS, Azure, GCP) including cloud\-native infrastructure, container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), and infrastructure\-as\-code tools (Terraform, Ansible).
* Familiarity with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS) and embedding models for semantic search and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG).
* Demonstrated ability to design clean APIs, modular microservices, and resilient, maintainable backend systems.
* Clear communicator with the ability to simplify complex AI system behaviors into actionable architecture.
* Passion for AI and a hunger to build systems that push the boundaries of autonomous software.
* Strong understanding of Agile software development, CI/CD practices, and collaborative team workflows.

**What you will bring:**


* BS or MS degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
* A solid foundation in software engineering principles, including system design, data structures, algorithms, and distributed computing.
* Proven ability to work in a fast\-paced, innovation\-driven environment where engineers take full ownership from concept to deployment.
* Experience deploying and operating intelligent systems in production environments with live users and evolving requirements.
* Curiosity, creativity, and the mindset of a builder — someone who thrives at the intersection of AI research and real\-world impact.
* Desire to help shape the future of software agents by building scalable, reliable, and intelligent backends that unlock new capabilities in autonomy and adaptability.

\#LI\-VB1


Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata We prioritize a people\-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well\-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are committed to actively working to foster an inclusive environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

The position is accountable for proactively soliciting and handling sales opportunities. Ensures business is turned over properly and in a timely fashion for proper service delivery. Assists in leading all day\-to\-day activities related to sales with a focus on building long\-term, value\-based customer relationships that enable achievement of sales objectives. Achieves personal sales goals.

* 2\-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 3 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.


OR


* 4\-year bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 1 year experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.

* Works collaboratively with off\-property sales channels to ensure sales efforts are coordinated, complementary and not duplicative.


* Builds and strengthens relationships with existing and new customers to enable future bookings. Activities include sales calls, entertainment, FAM trips, trade shows, etc.


* Develops relationships within community to strengthen and expand customer base for sales opportunities.


* Manages and develops relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.


* Provides accurate, complete and effective turnover to Event Management.

* Participates in sales calls with members of sales team to acquire new business and/or close on business.


* Executes and supports the operational aspects of business booked (e.g., generating proposal, writing contract, customer correspondence).

* Understands the overall market \- competitors’ strengths and weaknesses, economic trends, supply and demand etc. and knows how to sell against them.


* Closes the best opportunities for the location based on market conditions and location needs.


* Gains understanding of the location’s primary target customer and service expectations; serves the customer by understanding their business, business issues and concerns, to offer better business solution.

* Supports the company’s service and relationship strategy, driving customer loyalty by delivering service excellence throughout each customer experience.


* Services our customers in order to grow share of the account.

jobs.description:
Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.**Information Technology \& Digital**
-------------------------------------

In IT and D, you'll be a force for good, whether you're championing cyber security, defining how we harness the power of technology to improve our business, or working with data to guide the innovation of consumer loved products.  

  

Working globally across functions, you'll own your projects and process from start to finish, with the influence and visibility to achieve what needs to be done. And if you're willing to bring your ideas to the table, you'll get the support and investment to make them happen.  

  

Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. Every day, there will be opportunities to learn from peers and leaders through working on exciting, varied projects with real impact. And because our work spans so many different businesses, from Research and Product Development to Sales, you'll keep learning exciting new approaches.**About the role**
------------------



The Principal Business Analyst is responsible for the governance and enforcement of standardised solutions for projects, programme, and continuous improvement initiatives within their defined capability areas in OTC/STP/RTR/P\&BP/T\&E/C\&SF. They triage the demands from the respective capabilities and allocate them to the most suitable analyst, balancing capacity and opportunity for growth. The principal BA is responsible for line management activities for the team and supporting personal development plans.

**Your responsibilities**
-------------------------


* Supporting the implementation and business\-as\-usual running of Finance systems, e.g. Blackline, HighRadius, Concur, SAC etc
* Reviewing validation documentation, e.g. Validation Plans, Validation reports and other necessary SOX documents.
* Working with business users to understand the system requirements, technical issues, and support IT developer/vendor in addressing the needs.
* Working with delivery partners to ensure that any functional designs they are delivering are in line with standardised templates.
* Supporting the product managers in the delivery of demands and features through delegation to the team of BA’s
* Managing the team of BA’s and SBA’s
**The experience we're looking for**
------------------------------------


* Extensive experience working in a Business Analyst role like driving Requirements \& Design workshops with various Business \& IT stakeholders, SOX documentation skills, excellent communication skills and basic Finance process knowledge.
* Proven track record of expertise of suite of Finance solutions e.g.SAP (Required), Document Management System (preferred), Service Now (preferred), SAC(preferred), Azure Dev Ops(Required)etc.
* Hands on experience in creating Test Plans, and other relevant documentation required in regulated environments.
* Experience of working with and influencing senior stakeholders to balance business needs with IT standards and processes.
* Enthusiastic about the use of technology, with a proven ability to provide a communication ‘bridge’ between the business and technologists.
* Extensive experience of working in a mixed Waterfall and Agile delivery environment
* Experience of managing people, their workload, prioritisation and personal development
**The skills for success**
--------------------------



OTC/STP/RTR/P\&BP/T\&E/C\&SF, Team Management, Blackline, SOX

jobs.title: Agile Product Owner Advisor - HIH - Evernorth
jobs.description:
**Position Overview**
 The Agile Product Owner Advisor is a strategic and collaborative leader within an agile development team, responsible for managing the product backlog and ensuring that development efforts align with customer needs and business goals. This role involves translating high\-level business requirements into clear, actionable features, defining acceptance criteria, and prioritizing work to maximize value delivery. The Product Owner serves as the voice of the customer, working closely with developers, architects, operations, and business stakeholders to guide product development through iterative cycles.
   

  

 The Product Owner should embrace the “Product Mindset” and is expected to understand strategic roadmap goals, conduct customer interviews, analyze data, and participate in portfolio discussions to shape the product vision. They are empowered to support intake, prioritize delivery in partnership with business and Engineering, and ensure the Scrum team is focused on solving the right problems with innovative solutions. This role demands strong business and technical acumen, the ability to communicate effectively across teams, and a commitment to delivering measurable outcomes.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Understand and align product goals with strategic business objectives to ensure delivery of meaningful value.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with business and technology partners, fostering cross\-functional collaboration.
* Act as the primary contact for resolving escalations, removing impediments, and managing stakeholder negotiations and conflicts.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to onboard new initiatives and integrate them effectively into the product development lifecycle.
* Support the development of specifications, including value propositions and technical financial estimates, to guide delivery planning.
* Align with delivery teams to understand capacity and ensure prioritization is accurately reflected in the product backlog.
* Own and refine the product backlog, maintaining a steady flow of well\-defined work items for the development team.
* Analyze business needs and support requirement gathering, architecture discussions, and design decisions within agile teams.
* Translate business requirements into actionable features and define iteration scope to guide development.
* Participate actively in agile ceremonies and respond to team inquiries, clarifying features and acceptance criteria.
* Communicate the product vision and strategic decisions to the team, reinforcing customer\-centric thinking and business rationale.
* Conduct data analysis and profiling to support product decisions, including mapping source\-to\-target data and investigating issues using tools like SQL, SAS, or Python


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in MIS, Business, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 11\-13 years of experience in data analysis; Healthcare data domain experience and Agile certification (e.g., SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager) are highly desirable.
* Demonstrated experience as a Product Owner or in a similar role within Agile development environments, with a strong grasp of Agile principles, Scrum methodology, and modern delivery practices such as continuous integration and test\-driven development.
* Proven ability to translate complex business needs into clear, actionable features and acceptance criteria, with a focus on delivering customer\-centric solutions.
* Aptitude for gaining deep knowledge of the industry, business strategy, and key data domains (e.g., provider data, claims, membership, benefits), and proactively applying this knowledge to drive meaningful results.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship management skills, with the ability to facilitate collaboration across multiple functions, departments, and levels.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills, with the ability to influence and negotiate effectively across technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Proficiency in Agile and collaboration tools (JIRA) with hands\-on experience supporting agile ceremonies and backlog management.
* Advanced data analysis capabilities, including experience with SQL tools (e.g.,Toad, SAS, Alation), and data profiling techniques; familiarity with cloud technologies and data warehousing is a plus.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to investigate code, decode data issues, and support architecture and design decisions.
* Exceptional organizational and work management skills, with experience managing dependencies, risks, and delivery timelines in dynamic, lean/agile environments.


**Required Skills**
* Data Analytics Platforms (Databricks and/or Snowflake)
* Python, DevOps, Basic Cloud Experience (AWS/Azure).


**Preferred Skills, Experience \& Education**
* Cloud Certification (AWS Cloud Practitioner or similar)


**About Evernorth Health Services**
 Evernorth Health Services, a division of The Cigna Group, creates pharmacy, care and benefit solutions to improve health and increase vitality. We relentlessly innovate to make the prediction, prevention and treatment of illness and disease more accessible to millions of people. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

 Deccan AI builds enterprise AI systems that put accuracy at the center of intelligence. We work at the intersection of applied ML, data infrastructure, and product, helping organizations move from pilots to production grade AI. We're looking for a Technical Product Manager to help shape what we build next.
 



  





 We recently raised $25M in Series A funding and are entering a rapid growth phase. Our India office is based in Hyderabad.
 



 We’re not just participating in the AI race we’re building the infrastructure that powers it.
 



 With 1M\+ global experts, advanced automation, and vertically integrated platforms, we deliver the gold\-standard data that world\-class AI models rely on. The AI data infrastructure market is expected to grow exponentially over the next decade, and Deccan AI is positioned to become a defining company in this space.
 



  





**The Role** 
 We're hiring a Technical Product Manager to own the roadmap for one or more core product lines, working closely with engineering, applied ML, design, and go to market teams. This is a hands on role for someone comfortable reading a system design doc, writing a PRD, and sitting in on a customer call in the same afternoon.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Own the end to end product lifecycle: discovery, requirements, prioritization, launch, and iteration

* Translate customer and market signals into a prioritized roadmap backed by clear success metrics

jobs.description:
We have an exciting oppotunity of Product Costing Manager for our Auto Client based in Sohar, Oman
 



  





**Job Title:** 
 Product Costing Manager
 



**Location:** 
 Sohar, Oman
 



**Reporting:** 
 CFO
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




 We are looking for an experienced Cost Controller to join its Finance team and support growing
 



 manufacturing operations at the Sohar facility. This is a high\-visibility, cross\-functional role that sits at the intersection of Finance, Production, Supply Chain, and Sales — ensuring accurate cost data, robust reporting, and management insights that directly drive profitability and operational efficiency.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




 1\. Product Costing \& Standard Cost Management
 



 • Develop and maintain standard cost models for all product categories across the manufacturing line.
 



 • Review, validate, and ensure accuracy of Bills of Materials (BOMs) in coordination with Production and Engineering teams.
 



 • Update cost structures on an ongoing basis to reflect changes in raw material prices, labour costs, and overhead allocations.
 



 • Ensure accurate and up\-to\-date costing setup within the Odoo ERP system.
 



  





 2\. Production Cost Monitoring
 



 • Track actual manufacturing costs against standard costs — identifying gaps, overruns, and efficiency opportunities.
 



 • Analyse production orders and monitor cost per order across product lines and production batches.
 



 • Flag cost overruns and operational inefficiencies to Production and Finance management with root\-cause analysis.
 



  





 3\. Variance Analysis
 



 • Perform regular, structured variance analysis across key cost dimensions:
 



 – Material consumption variance — actual vs standard material usage
 



 – Labour efficiency variance — planned vs actual labour hours and cost
 



 – Production yield and wastage — scrap rates, rework costs, yield loss
 



 – Overhead absorption variance — fixed and variable overhead recovery
 



  





 4\. Inventory Cost Control
 



 • Monitor and maintain accurate valuation of raw materials, WIP (Work\-in\-Progress), and finished goods inventory.
 



 • Analyse inventory movements and proactively identify slow\-moving or obsolete materials.
 



 • Ensure correct costing of imported materials including landed costs, freight, duties, and customs charges.
 



 • Support periodic physical inventory counts, cycle counts, and reconciliations.
 



  





 5\. Cost Reporting
 



 • Prepare and distribute regular management reports including:
 



 – Product cost analysis by SKU and category
 



 – Manufacturing variance reports with root\-cause commentary
 



 – Profitability by product category and customer
 



 – Cost trend analysis — month\-on\-month and year\-on\-year
 



 – Production efficiency indicators and KPI dashboards
 



  





 6\. Pricing \& Commercial Support
 



 • Support Sales and Management in product pricing decisions by providing detailed cost breakdowns and margin analysis.
 



 • Ensure target margins are maintained across the product portfolio — flagging risks where pricing may erode profitability.
 



 • Evaluate the cost and profitability of new product introductions or customer\-specific requirements.
 



  





 7\. ERP \& Process Improvement
 



 • Maintain and continuously improve accurate costing structures within the Odoo ERP system.
 



 • Support ERP enhancements and improvements related to manufacturing costing modules and management
 



 reporting.
 



 • Identify and recommend process improvements to strengthen cost control, data integrity, and operational efficiency.
 



  





**Requirement:** 




 Education \& Experience
 


* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Cost Accounting.
* CMA, ACCA, or CPA certification (completed or in progress) preferred.
* 5\+ years of experience in cost accounting within a manufacturing environment.
* Background in industries such as automotive, furniture, joinery, construction materials, metals, or industrial manufacturing.
* Strong expertise in standard costing, BOM costing, variance analysis, and manufacturing finance.
* Experience in an international or expatriate manufacturing environment is an advantage.



 Technical Skills
 


* Strong knowledge of standard costing, absorption costing, overhead allocation, and variance analysis.
* Experience with Odoo ERP preferred; exposure to SAP, Oracle, or other manufacturing ERPs is acceptable.
* Advanced MS Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, reporting, and data analysis.
* Ability to analyze production and inventory data to support business decisions.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


At Amazon, we strive to be Earth's most customer\-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they want to buy online. Our mission in International Seller Services (ISS) is to provide technology solutions for improving the seller and customer experience, drive seller compliance, maximize seller success, and improve internal workforce productivity. Team's main focus is to build products that are scalable across different regions of the world, while working in partnership with ISS regional stakeholders and multiple partner teams across Amazon.  

  

As an Applied Scientist, you will be responsible for modeling complex problems, discovering insights, and building risk algorithms that identify opportunities through statistical models, machine learning, and visualization techniques to improve operational efficiency.  

  

As an Applied Scientist, you will leverage your expertise in Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing (NLP), and Large Language Models (LLM) to develop innovative solutions for Amazon's ISS team. You'll be responsible for modeling complex problems, building innovative algorithms, and discovering actionable insights through statistical models and visualization techniques to enhance operational efficiency in the e\-commerce space. The role combines usage of latest AI technology with practical business applications, requiring someone passionate about transforming the way we interact with technology while delivering measurable impact through advanced analytics and machine learning solutions.  

  

You will need to collaborate effectively with business and product leaders within ISS and cross\-functional teams to build scalable solutions against high organizational standards. The candidate should be able to apply a breadth of tools, data sources, and Data Science techniques to answer a wide range of high\-impact business questions and proactively present new insights in concise and effective manner.  

The candidate should be an effective communicator capable of independently driving issues to resolution and communicating insights to non\-technical audiences. This is a high impact role with goals that directly impacts the bottom line of the business.  

  

Responsibilities: \- Analyze terabytes of data to define and deliver on complex analytical deep dives to unlock insights and build scalable solutions through science to ensure security of Amazon’s platform and transactions  

  

Build Machine Learning and/or statistical models that evaluate the transaction legitimacy and track impact over time  

Ensure data quality throughout all stages of acquisition and processing, including data sourcing/collection, ground truth generation, normalization, transformation, and cross\-lingual alignment/mapping  

Define and conduct experiments to validate/reject hypotheses, and communicate insights and recommendations to Product and Tech teams  

Develop efficient data querying infrastructure for both offline and online use cases  

Collaborate with cross\-functional teams from multidisciplinary science, engineering and business backgrounds to enhance current automation processes  

Learn and understand a broad range of Amazon’s data resources and know when, how, and which to use and which not to use.  

Maintain technical document and communicate results to diverse audiences with effective writing, visualizations, and presentations  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* You will extract huge volumes of data from various sources and construct complex analyses.
* You should be detail\-oriented and must have an aptitude for solving unstructured problems. You should work in a self\-directed environment, own tasks and drive them to completion
* You should have excellent business and communication skills to be able to work with business owners to develop and define key business questions and to build data sets that answer those questions. You own customer relationship about data and execute tasks that are manifestations of such ownership, like ensuring high data availability, low latency, documenting data details and transformations and handling user notifications and training
* You will work with distributed machine learning and statistical algorithms upon a large Hadoop cluster to harness enormous volumes at scale to serve our customers
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of building machine learning models for business application experience
* PhD, or Master's degree and 6\+ years of applied research experience
* Experience programming in Java, C\+\+, Python or related language
* Experience with neural deep learning methods and machine learning

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with modeling tools such as R, scikit\-learn, Spark MLLib, MxNet, Tensorflow, numpy, scipy etc.
* Experience with large scale distributed systems such as Hadoop, Spark etc.

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

This role focuses on the detailed documentation of source tables, data structures, lineage, and business meaning, ensuring that critical enterprise data assets are fully specified, governed, and discoverable within enterprise data governance platforms.
  
The role partners closely with business stakeholders, analytic teams, and data engineering to translate enterprise data assets intowell‑documented, observable, and trusted data products, with specifications maintained centrally in governance and metadata management tools such asCollibra.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Data Specification Metadata Capture
  
  

* Lead the identification and documentation ofdata specifications for Platinum‑level enterprise data sources, including:
* Source systems and source tables
* Key data elements and attributes
* Transformation logic and dependencies
* End‑to‑end data lineage
* Gather, define, and maintainbusiness metadata, including:
* Business definitions and terminology
* Metric descriptions and business context
* Data ownership and stewardship assignments
* Ensure bothbusiness and technical metadata are complete, accurate, and aligned to enterprise standards.


Enterprise Data Governance Enablement
  
  

* Ensure all data specifications and metadata areregistered, maintained, and governed within enterprise data governance tools, with a primary focus onCollibra.
* Support governance workflows including:
* Data asset onboarding and certification
* Business glossary curation
* Stewardship reviews and approvals
* Partner with data owners, stewards, and governance teams to ensure Platinum data sources meetcertification, transparency, and auditability expectations.


Data Lineage, Architecture Observability
  
  

* Work closely with data engineering and platform teams to documentlogical and physical data lineage from source through analytic consumption.
* Capture and maintaindata architecture artifacts that support impact analysis and change management.
* Partner with engineering to define and automatedata observability specifications and reporting, aligning quality, freshness, and reliability indicators back to documented data assets.


Cross‑Functional Partnership
  
  

* Act as a liaison betweenbusiness, analytics, governance, and engineering teams, ensuring consistent understanding of enterprise data definitions and specifications.
* Facilitate specification walkthroughs, design reviews, and metadata validation sessions.
* Support analytic and reporting teams by ensuring Platinum data products areclearly specified, trusted, and discoverable for reuse.


Required Qualifications
  
  

* 5–6 years of experience in data management, data operations, business analysis, or analytics enablement.
* Strong experience documentingdata specifications, including source tables, lineage, and metadata.
* Hands‑on experience withenterprise data governance and metadata tools, preferablyCollibra.
* Solid understanding of:
* Enterprise data architectures (data warehouse, lakehouse)
* Analytic and reporting consumption patterns
* Data certification and governed data products
* Ability to translate complex technical structures intoclear business metadata and documentation.
* Demonstrated experience working with business stakeholders, analytic users, and data engineers.


Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience supportingPlatinum / Tier‑0 / certified enterprise data sources.
* Familiarity withdata observability and data reliability concepts.
* Experience documentingend‑to‑end lineage and data architectures in complex enterprise environments.
* Exposure to regulated or compliance‑driven data domains.
* Experience working within aDataOps or product‑oriented data organization.


Key Competencies
  
  

* Data specification and metadata management
* Business and technical translation
* Governance‑first mindset
* Attention to detail and data accuracy
* Cross‑functional collaboration and influence

Role Summary
  
TheData Operations Project Manager is responsible for leading and coordinating enterprise initiatives focused on theidentification, documentation, and operational readiness of “Platinum” data sources. This role ensures that critical data assets are fully documented—includingdata ownership, end‑to‑end lineage, and business metadata—so they can be confidently consumed by next‑generation analytics platforms and tools.
  
The Project Manager acts as theorchestrator across DataOps analysts, data engineering, governance, and analytics teams, driving execution against clearly defined milestones, dependencies, and quality standards. This role is not focused on application delivery; instead, it ensures thatdata documentation and metadata work is executed consistently, on time, and at enterprise scale, enabling trusted analytics, certified datasets, and reusable data products.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Data Documentation Platinum Readiness Delivery
  
  

* Lead cross‑functional initiatives to identify, prioritize, and documentPlatinum‑level data sources across enterprise domains.
* Own project plans and execution for documenting:
* Data ownership (business owner, technical owner, stewardship roles)
* End‑to‑end data lineage (source → transformations → analytical consumption)
* Business metadata (definitions, context, usage intent, metric alignment)
* Ensure documentation outputs meet definedPlatinum entry criteria and are complete, consistent, and audit‑ready.


Program Dependency Management
  
  

* Develop and manage detailed project plans, milestones, and dependencies across DataOps analysts, data engineers, governance teams, and analytics consumers.

* Actively manage risks, issues, and scope to ensure delivery remains aligned to enterprise priorities and Platinum standards.


Governance Metadata Enablement
  
  

* Partner closely with enterprise data governance teams to ensure Platinum documentation is:
* Registered in approved metadata and governance platforms
* Aligned to enterprise naming, definition, and stewardship standards
* Maintained through defined change and certification workflows
* Ensure documentation artifacts support downstream capabilities such as certified semantic layers, impact analysis, and analytics discoverability.


Stakeholder Executive Engagement
  
  

* Serve as the primary point of coordination between business stakeholders, analytics teams, DataOps, and technology partners for Platinum documentation initiatives.
* Provide clear, executive‑level status reporting on progress, risks, and readiness.

Operating Model Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Help operationalize repeatable delivery patterns, templates, and playbooks for data documentation and Platinum onboarding.
* Identify opportunities to improve speed, quality, and consistency of metadata capture and lineage documentation.
* Contribute to the maturation of the Data Operations delivery and governance operating model.


Required Qualifications
  
  

* 5 years of experience inproject or program management supporting data, analytics, or enterprise information initiatives.
* Proven experience coordinating cross‑functional teams indata‑heavy, matrixed environments.
* Strong understanding of:
* Data ownership models and stewardship concepts
* Data lineage (technical and business perspectives)
* Business metadata and analytical data readiness
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex data concepts into clear plans, milestones, and executive‑level updates.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.


Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience working withinData Operations, Data Governance, Analytics Enablement, or Data Product organizations.
* Familiarity with enterprise data governance or metadata platforms (e.g., data catalogs, lineage tools).
* Experience supporting certified datasets, semantic layers, or analytics platforms (e.g., lakehouse, BI, advanced analytics tools).

jobs.description:
**Job Requirements**  

**Role Purpose**


Key process owner for New Product introduction from the merchandising side .


This role works closely with various key stakeholders \- Design, NPI, Regional Sourcing, Manufacturing and category teams to ensure on time delivery of New product protos .

  

**Key Responsibilities**


**1\. New Product calendarization , New product process management and New product profitability adherence**


* Coordination with the category team for creation of the NPD calendar
* On time adherence of brief creation by the category team and relaying the same forward to other stakeholders like Design /Sourcing.
* Maintenance of the New product launched dashboard by vendor \& need state and alert category in case of excess or starvation as per the planned New product number
* Ensuring through his/her team the timely release of PDIS for the new products selected by the category team within a day .
* Ensuring that Benchmark GC ( BMCG) and AMC\-LC is validated for all new products before the PDIS is released
* Ensuring that the fill rate against brief is at least 95% for all briefs released to the NPD team
* Maintain a stage gate process chart for all critical new product development projects initiated by the merchandising team
* Lead the periodic meetings between Design / NPI and merchandising to ensure adherence of time for the new products selected.
* Flag of any deviations / delays in timeline for protos in advance with specific call out of the stage where the delay is occurring.
  

**2\. Planning \& execution of NPIM for both L1\|L2 and L3 channels**


* Managing the NPD team to ensure that the NPIMs ( both Offline \& Online) are scheduled \& completed on time and the hit rates are shared with the respective stakeholders – Category , NPI \& Design
* Coordinate with the L3 team to ensure that the L3 indents at the NPIM are processed within 3 days
* Take end to end responsibility \& Ownership of the protos brought for the NPIM till the return is completed without any damage or loss.
* Ensure RSO \& Franchisee satisfaction during the NPIM process in terms of boarding , lodging , transportation as well as the indenting process.
* Ensuring that the Quality walk through with the QA team happens post each NPIM.
  

**3\. Driving Operational excellence \& Lead time reduction**


* Owner of the New Product development portal ( BSID) portal and ensure that the critical responsibility of ensuring that the key stakeholders have visibility on the stage \& the time elapsed since selection of the design.
* Coordinating with the IT team to integrate all new product developments ( DEC designed) into the New Product development portal
* Coordinating with the IT team to ensure that all stages of proto development right from the first stage (selection of proto) to the final stage ( bulk indent) is visible on the portal
* Drive the lead time goal of selection to inwarding of selected protos ( In Tanishq quality ) in 7 days for all protos using the portal effectively.
* Ensuring proto bin liquidation through periodic nudges \& interaction with the category team.
* Evangelizing and Driving the adoption of Bottom up feedback portal ( Design instigator) by the store teams and ensuring that any product gap feedback is captured only though the Design Instigator portal
  

**4\. New Product insights , development of new skillsets and new vendor onboarding**


* Ensuring New vendor onboarding on the basis of the new requirement ( through Instigator portal) and the current skill set gaps in workmanship \& Innovation
* Coordinating the participation in various trade shows ( IIJS / Jaipur Jewellery show ..etc)
* Collation of new trends seen across vendors as an input to the category team
* Ensuring that the new product briefs are released to the vendors with the right skillset thereby ensuring that the briefs for products with lower complexity are with cost effective partners ( KP/KC)
  

**5\. People Management**


* Responsibility of allocation of the various deliverables to the right team member
* Grooming of the team to ensure that they take on higher order responsibilities
* Periodic reviews \& appraisal of the team’s work
  

  

  

**Work Experience**  

**Internal \& External Interfaces**


* Internal: Design, NPI, Category, Sourcing, ISCM, IT, Regional Merchandiser \& sales team
* External: Vendors, Franchisee partners, Hospitality \& setup partners
  

**Required Qualifications / Experience / Behavioural Skills**


* Graduate or MBA for a reputed college or university.
* **7–10 years** of experience in Jewellery business with a strong understanding of the product development process.
* Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders and work on tight timelines
* Ability to manage a team
* Experience in Oracle will help.

**About Skillz**



If you want to build, own, and see your impact — join Skillz and level up your career.



Skillz is the competition infrastructure platform that powers real\-money, skill\-based tournaments inside mobile games. We didn't just enter the competitive gaming market — we invented it. Founded in 2012 by entrepreneur and inventor Andrew Paradise, Skillz built the category from scratch: the patented matchmaking, identity, payments, fraud protection, and developer tools that make fair, real\-stakes competition possible at scale.



Skillz hosts billions of casual mobile gaming tournaments for millions of players worldwide and is revolutionizing the gaming industry. By fostering social competition within games, the Skillz platform helps developers build multi\-million dollar franchises by enabling real\-money activity in their games and providing operational support while connecting players through fair, enjoyable, and meaningful competition.



Today, Skillz is part of FIRY — a global holding company operating at the intersection of gaming, AI\-powered performance marketing, and developer infrastructure. Alongside RZR, our AI\-driven ad network, and Beamable, our backend and LiveOps platform, Skillz sits at the center of a compounding data flywheel that no standalone competitor can replicate. 800,000\+ daily tournaments. $7\.5 billion in lifetime prizes paid to players. 90 million registered users.

**Key Competencies**


* Strategic Vision: Develop and drive product strategy aligned with business goals in the real money gaming industry.

---------------


Amazon Web Services is seeking a results\-driven Senior Account\-Based Marketing (ABM) Manager for India FSI \& Conglomerates to design and execute high\-impact ABM programs for Financial Services (Banking, Insurance, Capital Markets) customers and large Indian Conglomerate groups (e.g., Tata Group, Adani, Mahindra). Working backwards from customer needs, you will create data\-driven, multi\-channel campaigns, events, and executive programs that accelerate pipeline and revenue growth. This role requires deep understanding of India's FSI landscape (regulated banks, insurers, capital markets firms), conglomerate buying dynamics, and the ability to build scalable demand generation engines with measurable pipeline contribution.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Develop and execute ABM 1:1 and 1:Few marketing strategies for priority FSI customers in India (banking, insurance, capital markets) and large Indian Conglomerates, in collaboration with Account Managers and Business Leaders, with the goal of maximizing AWS revenue
* Act as the primary marketing contact for the FSI \& Conglomerates segment, working across partner organizations, Solutions Architects, WWSO, and Sales units along with regional and global marketing stakeholders
* Drive demand generation activities that enable the FSI \& Conglomerates business to acquire new customers, retain and grow existing customers, and deliver revenue growth from AWS services — across banking institutions, insurance firms, and conglomerate groups like Tata, Adani, Mahindra etc.

* Develop and implement scalable campaign playbooks for driving demand gen motion in collaboration with FSI Focussed partners like GSIs, ISVs and SIs.

* Design executive engagement programs for CXOs at banks, insurance companies, and conglomerate group\-level technology leaders — including BFSI summits, innovation showcases, CXO roundtables, and boardroom\-level engagements

------------------------

* Experience in a business\-to\-business (B2B) environment, high\-tech products/services

* Experience developing and executing campaigns across a multitude of timezones and languages
* Knowledge of advanced skills in Excel as well as any data visualization tools like Tableau or similar BI tools (familiarity with Tableau preferred)

jobs.description:
**Role:** 
 Product Manager
 



**Function:** 
 Product Management
 



**Location:** 
 Bengaluru
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Industry:** 
 Accounting, AI/ML, B2B SaaS, Fintech
 



  





**About Company** 




 An early\-stage AI startup founded in 2025, based in Singapore and Bengaluru. The company is building an AI platform purpose\-built for independent accounting firms in North America.
 



 Its platform acts as a specialised junior accountant, automating routine tasks within a human\-in\-the\-loop model. Firms using the platform report productivity gains exceeding five times in targeted workflows.
 



 The company raised $6 million in seed funding in April 2026 and operates with a lean team of eight. It targets the $150 billion global accounting sector — a space still largely untouched by modern tooling.
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 We're looking for a Product Manager who sits at the intersection of US tax domain expertise and AI product thinking. You'll own the product roadmap for our core accounting workflows, work directly with CPA users to extract real pain points, and ship prototypes fast enough to bring to the next discovery call. This is a hands\-on, zero\-ambiguity role at a seed\-stage company where your output ships to real firms within weeks.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibilities** 



* Own end\-to\-end product discovery with CPA firm users — map workflows, extract latent needs, and separate critical pain points from nice\-to\-haves
* Translate discovery findings into precise specs with clear data models, edge cases, and testable acceptance criteria that engineers can act on immediately
* Build demoable prototypes of new features within days of a discovery session using low\-code tools, prompt chains, or lightweight front\-ends
* Define and maintain the product roadmap for core tax and accounting workflows, prioritising ruthlessly against firm\-level ROI
* Participate in technical design discussions on agentic architectures, retrieval approaches, and API integration patterns — contributing meaningfully without being the engineer
* Act as the quality bar for AI output accuracy — catch hallucinated tax rules, misclassified entity types, or incorrect workflow logic before they reach users
* Manage stakeholder communication across founders, CPA firm partners, and enterprise clients — async\-first, no\-surprises updates that don't require a meeting to understand



  





**Must Have Criteria** 



* 3\+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS — with at least some exposure to accounting, tax, fintech, or financial workflows (CPA firm experience is a strong plus, not a strict requirement)
* Familiarity with CPA firm or financial services workflows — document collection, review cycles, compliance deadlines, or regulated data handling — either through direct experience or adjacent fintech products
* Daily power user of frontier AI tools (Claude, GPT\-4o, Cursor, v0, or Bolt) — uses them to accelerate discovery, prototyping, and spec writing
* Ability to write structured prompts and system instructions for AI agents — understands context windows, tool\-calling, and practical failure modes
* Demonstrated ability to build a demoable feature prototype within days using low\-code tools or prompt chains — not slides, a working demo
* Writes specs engineers don't have to decipher — clear data models, edge cases called out, acceptance criteria that can be tested
* Proven track record of running structured user discovery sessions and translating ambiguous feedback into prioritised, actionable requirements



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Direct experience at a CPA firm, tax software company (UltraTax, Lacerte, Drake, CCH Axcess), or fintech serving accountants
* Experience with workflow automation platforms — Zapier, Make, n8n, or Python\-based document parsing pipelines (OCR, structured extraction)
* Familiarity with IRS compliance constraints: PTIN/EFIN requirements, IRC §7216 data privacy, e\-filing deadlines, and audit trail expectations
* Experience working at a seed or Series A startup where you owned the full product lifecycle with minimal process overhead
* Ability to review PRs for conceptual correctness — not code style, but whether the implementation matches what was agreed to build



  





**What We Offer** 



* Direct impact — your roadmap decisions ship to real CPA firms within weeks, not quarters
* Founder\-level access — work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with the founding team on product strategy and customer discovery
* The rare chance to define the product category for AI in independent accounting — a $150B sector that's still largely untouched by modern tooling

**About Us**
 Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
   

  

 At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
   

  

 Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Job Summary:
   

  

 Product Managers in Product Development/Management drive product strategy from conception and definition through implementation. They identify new business and market opportunities, create business plans, and determine market requirements for products, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and image. The role functions as a central resource, interacting with systems, marketing, and sales during product development, and formulates and executes long\-term plans for cost and profit control. Product Managers promote the use of new technologies and industry\-leading trends.
   

  

 All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Direct product strategy from conception through implementation.
* Identify and evaluate new business and market opportunities.
* Develop business plans and determine market requirements for products.
* Ensure product consistency with organizational image and objectives.
* Serve as a central resource, collaborating with systems, marketing, and sales during product development.
* Formulate and execute long\-term plans for cost and profit control.
* Promote adoption of new technologies and industry\-leading trends.


 Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
   

  

**Qualifications**

* 5 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or at least 2 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 0 years of work experience with a PhD.
* Experience in product management, product ownership, business process analysis, or sales operations.
* Experience applying Agile principles across design, development, testing, and product management.
* Experience developing software capabilities to support sales, service, or customer relationship management functions.
* Experience in managing and implementing complex projects directly or through supervision.
* Experience working in cross\-functional teams to implement and assess operational impact of process changes.
* Experience soliciting and translating user feedback to inform product development.
* Experience driving product development with high velocity and quality.
* Experience in project management techniques, methodologies, and best practices such as Agile.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Agile certifications such as CSM and CSPO, or their equivalent.
* Experience working with issuers and clients in the financial services industry or high\-growth technology companies.
* Experience in product management in payments, common services, and identity and access management.
* Experience in API development using SOAP or REST, JSON, and XML.
* Experience in API security, security standards, data encryption, and HSMs.
* Experience managing cross\-functional teams in global, highly matrixed organizations.
* Experience developing and executing product strategies that drive adoption and revenue growth.


**Visa is an EEO Employer**
 Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

 Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full\-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business \- without vendor lock\-in or costly implementation cycles.

Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context\-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities \- AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real\-time. **Job Description**
**Product Manager**
*TechGrove AI Engineering Pod*
 You are the person who makes a great engineering team feel effortless. You turn priorities into a clean backlog, protect the team’s focus, remove obstacles before they become blockers, and give leadership a calm, honest view of progress and risk. You love shipping, and you measure yourself by what the team delivers.
   

  

 As Product Manager, you own the delivery engine of an AI Engineering Pod. You are not the Product Owner: the OpCo keeps ownership of product vision and prioritization. You are accountable for turning that vision into shipped features. You own the backlog, drive the cadence, and run the pod as a high\-performing, AI\-native Agile team.
   

  

 If you want to run delivery for a small, senior team building with AI at its core, this role is for you.
   

  

**About The Pod**
 A TechGrove AI Engineering Pod is a self\-contained, AI\-native software delivery team that we embed inside one of our Operating Companies (OpCos) to build, modernize, and ship production software. Each pod pairs senior engineering talent with agentic AI tooling such as Claude Code, plus the accelerators of Banyan’s AI Application Modernization Factory, to deliver at a velocity and quality bar a traditional team cannot match.
   

  

 A pod is typically four to eight people, and OpCos add more pods as their ambitions grow. You will work as part of a tight, high\-trust team with real ownership of what you build. Pods are delivered from Banyan’s India\-based TechGrove.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Own feature delivery: Own end\-to\-end delivery from backlog to production, accountable for the pod consistently shipping high\-quality software against the Product Owner’s priorities.
* Manage the backlog: Own and groom the product backlog, translating the Product Owner’s vision into well\-formed, ready\-to\-build user stories with clear acceptance criteria.
* Facilitate Agile: Run the pod’s ceremonies (sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, reviews, retrospectives), protecting focus, removing impediments, and continuously improving throughput.
* Align stakeholders: Serve as the primary delivery interface between the pod and OpCo stakeholders, managing expectations and communicating progress, risks, and trade\-offs.
* Champion AI\-native delivery: Adapt Agile practice for a team that builds with agentic tooling (Claude Code and similar): how work is decomposed, estimated, reviewed, and accepted when much of the build is AI\-driven.
* Drive predictability with metrics: Establish and track delivery metrics (velocity, cycle time, quality), and use the data to forecast, surface risk early, and drive predictable outcomes.
* Manage risk and dependencies: Identify and manage cross\-team dependencies, delivery risks, and blockers, escalating and resolving them to keep the pod moving.
* Uphold the definition of done: Ensure features are tested, secure, and production\-ready before release.


**What You Bring**
* Experience: 5\+ years in product management, delivery management, and/or Scrum Master roles for software engineering teams, with a track record of shipping production software.
* Agile mastery: Deep, hands\-on command of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and the facilitation skills to run a high\-performing delivery team. CSM/PSM or equivalent is a plus.
* Backlog and requirements: Proven ability to manage a product backlog and translate vision into clear, buildable user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Technical fluency: Strong technical literacy to work credibly with senior and principal engineers: software architecture, APIs, cloud\-native delivery, and modern SDLC trade\-offs.
* AI fluency: Hands\-on familiarity with AI\-assisted development tooling (Claude Code or similar) and a clear point of view on how agentic development changes workflow, estimation, and quality practices.
* Stakeholder management: Exceptional communication, with a proven ability to align business and technical stakeholders and manage competing priorities.
* Ownership and ambiguity: A proactive ownership mindset and comfort operating amid the ambiguity and rapid change of embedded, fast\-moving delivery teams.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience leading delivery for B2B or enterprise SaaS products.
* Prior experience in a consulting, professional\-services, or embedded\-team model serving external client organizations.
* Familiarity with application modernization or re\-platforming programs.
* Experience defining delivery metrics and reporting for executive stakeholders.


**What Success Looks Like**
* First 90 days: The pod has a clean, prioritized backlog, a steady cadence, and clear metrics, and OpCo stakeholders have a predictable, trusted view of delivery.
* First 6 months: Delivery is consistent and forecastable, the team’s AI\-native ways of working are tuned and improving, and stakeholders rely on the pod to deliver.


**Why TechGrove, Why Banyan**
* Permanent home, long\-term thinking: Banyan acquires great software businesses and keeps them for good. We invest for the long term, which means you build software meant to last, not to flip.
* Real ownership: You own outcomes end to end inside a small, senior team. The OpCo owns the “what”; the pod owns the “how.”
* AI\-native by default: You work every day with agentic tooling and the AI Application Modernization Factory, not as a side experiment but as the core of how we build.
* Variety with stability: Pods work across a portfolio of real products and domains, so you keep learning, with the security of a permanent employer behind you.

 Hyperproof is on a mission to transform the Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) world with a powerful new software platform. With Hyperproof, companies can save time and money while also operating their programs at a much higher level of effectiveness and accountability. We envision a world where organizations we depend on are truly trustworthy — and Hyperproof is the platform that will get them there.
 



 We have a great team and culture — picture yourself in a highly collaborative startup environment where you can make a real impact on something truly important. It's an exciting time to be at Hyperproof; we raised our Series B round in 2023, validating our teamwork and company vision, and we continue to grow rapidly.
 



 Hyperproof is hiring a Product Manager to join our growing product team, focused on our Risk Management product area — spanning both first\-party risk management and third\-party risk management (TPRM).
 



**What You'll Do** 




 In this role, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of features across two interconnected and high\-growth product areas: first\-party risk management (risk register, control testing, risk scoring, framework alignment) and third\-party risk management (vendor assessments, vendor lifecycle, questionnaire automation, risk scoring). You will be empowered with the autonomy needed to drive successful outcomes and shape how organizations understand and manage risk holistically.
 



  
 


* Own the product roadmap for first\-party and third\-party risk management, making prioritization decisions grounded in customer research, market trends, and business impact.
* Define and drive delivery of features across the full risk lifecycle: risk identification, assessment, scoring, monitoring, remediation, and vendor collaboration workflows.

* You will create insightful solutions that land well with customers and open new segments of the market.
* You will identify new opportunities at the intersection of first\-party and third\-party risk and propose innovative ways to approach them.
* You will be a valued team player who helps those around you do their best work.



**What You'll Bring** 




  
 


* 5\+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning and shipping features for enterprise or B2B SaaS products.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* Excellent communication skills — the ability to build alignment and clarity across technical and non\-technical audiences, including engineering, design, executives, and customers.
* Demonstrated ability to gather and synthesize customer feedback, market research, and business requirements to inform product strategy and prioritization.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with a data\-driven approach to decision\-making.
* Experience writing clear, well\-structured product specs and user stories that engineering teams can build from confidently.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously in a fast\-paced, agile environment.
* Deep curiosity — you delve into the details to understand root causes of problems, unexpected user behavior, and unmet needs.
* A genuine team player — people around you do better work because of your enthusiasm, openness, and willingness to help.



**What Will Be a Plus** 



* Experience in the governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) or cybersecurity domain — as a practitioner, product manager, or power user.
* Familiarity with third\-party risk management programs, vendor assessment workflows, or supplier risk concepts.
* Experience with compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, or similar.
* You have shipped AI\-assisted or AI\-enabled product features in a production environment.
* Experience working with or alongside vendor risk, information security, or procurement teams.



**Location**

**Company Overview**
 Cigna Healthcare is a global health service company dedicated to improving the health, well‑being, and peace of mind of those we serve by making healthcare simple, affordable, and predictable. We are a mature yet evolving organization with a strong focus on Agile ways of working.
   

  

 Together with colleagues across Kuala Lumpur, Bengaluru, Nairobi, Antwerp, and Madrid, you will support our International Organisations Health (IOH) business lines, serving over 500,000 customers worldwide.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Product Owner is accountable for maximizing value delivery at the Scrum Team level by translating product strategy and priorities into high\-quality, executable backlog items. Working in close partnership with the Agile Product Manager (APM), the Product Owner ensures customer needs, business outcomes, and delivery commitments are effectively balanced and realized through predictable, high\-quality delivery. The Product Owner acts as the voice of the customer for the Scrum Team and plays a critical role in enabling continuous improvement and value realization.
   

  

 The role is responsible for IOH backend products across Mainframe and Financial Services domains, including payments, billing, eligibility, and finance operations, supporting internal business processes and integrations. A key focus area will be driving the delivery of reliable, compliant, and scalable capabilities for payment processing, financial reporting, and data integrity, including integration with external vendors and internal platforms and addressing the needs of internal IOH stakeholders such as operations, finance, claims, eligibility, and back\-office teams.
   

  

 Ideal candidate must possess a broad base of skills and knowledge spanning technology, financial operations and healthcare administration within International Health, user experience design, and agile development practices. The individual will work with multiple stakeholders to determine the business and technology objectives for their team and ensure solutions deliver tangible business value.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with the Agile Product Manager to support product vision, roadmap, and outcomes aligned with business strategy and customer needs.
* Ensure delivery progress and milestones are visible to keep roadmaps relevant and timely.
* Act as the voice of the customer for the Scrum Team, ensuring backlog priorities reflect customer value.

* Customer\-centric mindset and empathy.
* Ability to translate strategy into executable outcomes.
* Ownership, accountability, and attention to quality.
* Collaboration and stakeholder management skills.
* Continuous improvement and data\-driven mindset.

**About Us**
 At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As the Product Owner – Microsegmentation, you will define the vision, roadmap, and delivery of segmentation capabilities helping prevent lateral movement and protect critical assets across on\-prem and cloud platforms.
   

  

 You will work at the intersection of security engineering, architecture, and business delivery owning outcomes, not just technology.
   

  

 The Product Owner constantly prioritises tasks and squad(s)backlog(s)with the customer at the heart of their decision making. The Product Owner also ensures that the work is strategically aligned to the portfolio mission and engages with other Product Owners to align and manage interdependencies. Whilst this role is not usually a people manager (there will be some instances where this occurs), it is a key leadership role, galvanising the squad(s)around a vision and supporting them to successfully deliver customer value at pace.
   

  

 Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.

 As a Product Owner (Microsegmentation) you are a:

* Voice of the customer – Must continually engage with the customer and stakeholders to ensure squad is working on the right things and represents what is valuable to the customer

* Own one or more enterprise PLM capabilities end to end, from strategic intake and prioritization through delivery, release, adoption, and continuous optimization, ensuring solutions support supply chain effectiveness, product readiness, and business continuity

* Define and execute UAT strategy and sign‑off, ensuring SOX compliance, audit readiness, and controlled risk mitigation for production releases

 Education and Experience
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Information Systems, Business, or equivalent experience
* Extensive experience in PLM, ERP, and supply‑chain‑integrated systems, preferably in complex, global enterprise environments
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA preferred, or comparable enterprise platforms
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, strategic initiatives in matrixed organizations
* Familiarity with Agile or user‑story‑based delivery models


 Knowledge and Skills
   

  

* Deep knowledge of PLM concepts, including BOM structures, product master data, and lifecycle governance
* Strong understanding of how product data, PLM governance, and system decisions impact supply chain performance and business risk
* Experience operating in compliance‑driven and audit‑controlled environments
* Familiarity with system integrations, data flows, and cross‑platform dependencies
* Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and decision‑making skills
* Ability to synthesize complex data and ambiguity into clear recommendations and executive‑ready guidance


 Leadership Skills and Behaviors
   

  

* Leads through influence across business, IT, and supply chain stakeholders
* Operates independently on complex problems requiring in‑depth evaluation of multiple factors
* Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and follow‑through for strategic decisions and outcomes
* Comfortable engaging with senior leaders, defending recommendations, and advising on trade‑offs, risks, and growth opportunities
* Exhibits learning agility, digital fluency, and a continuous improvement mindset aligned with HP values


 Impact \& Scope
   

  

* Impacts enterprise supply chain and product lifecycle capabilities, providing expertise and leadership across functional and cross‑functional initiatives
* Contributes to the development of competitive, scalable supply chain solutions through standardized PLM capabilities

* Build and maintain data pipelines and workflows
